title: Keep the default Core embedding port wired to the Commercial bus plug
goal: Make the existing bus-only local embedding provider available in the lean default susi-gmcp build so an attached Commercial gpu_fabric.embed.texts plug can serve embeddings without enabling tools-rich or moving the embedding engine into Core.
